items.title_en: ChatGPT voice mode is a weaker model
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 语音模式其实用了更弱的模型
items.summary_en: Simon Willison points out that OpenAI's advanced voice mode still relies on a noticeably weaker model than the one behind the main text chat experience. His takeaway is practical: the polished speech interface can hide a real capability drop, so people evaluating AI assistants should separate product smoothness from model quality and be careful when assuming voice and text are equally strong.
items.summary_zh: Simon Willison 认为，OpenAI 的高级语音模式背后使用的模型能力明显弱于主文本聊天版本。文章的关键提醒很实际：流畅自然的语音交互很容易让人误以为底层模型同样强大，但真正决定回答质量的仍然是模型本身，而不是界面包装。对于评估 AI 助手的人来说，这意味着不能把“说得更像人”直接等同于“推理和知识水平一样强”。

items.summary_en: Anil Dash argues that the software industry is moving into a new security crisis because LLMs are rapidly improving at both generating code and finding exploitable weaknesses in it. His central point is that AI does not just speed up attackers; it also changes the tempo and scale of the whole defense problem, forcing teams to rethink how they review, ship, and secure modern software.
items.summary_zh: Anil Dash 认为，软件行业正在走向一个新的安全拐点，因为 LLM 在生成代码和发现可利用漏洞这两方面都在快速进步。文章真正想强调的不是 AI 只会让攻击者更快，而是它正在改变整个安全攻防的节奏和规模。过去依赖人工审查、缓慢修补和经验判断的做法，会越来越难跟上模型驱动的速度，因此团队需要重新思考软件开发、审计和防御的基本流程。

items.title_en: Has Mythos just broken the deal that kept the internet safe?
items.title_zh: Mythos 是否打破了维持互联网安全的旧平衡？
items.summary_en: Martin Alderson uses Anthropic's restricted Mythos release to argue that browser sandboxes and virtual machines may no longer be enough if frontier models can reliably discover and chain real exploits. He frames the issue as a broken social bargain: the web stayed usable because finding working attacks was expensive, and if AI sharply lowers that cost, long-standing assumptions about internet safety could fail very quickly.
items.summary_zh: Martin Alderson 借 Anthropic 对 Mythos 的受限发布提出了一个更尖锐的问题：如果前沿模型已经能稳定发现并串联真实漏洞，那么浏览器沙箱和虚拟机这些传统隔离手段，可能不再足以维持互联网原有的安全平衡。文章把这件事描述为一种“旧协议”正在失效：过去网络还能勉强保持可用，是因为真正可落地的攻击发现成本很高，而 AI 一旦大幅压低这个成本，很多默认成立的安全假设就可能迅速崩塌。
